limitations: Archive CRC and gzip checks do not prove a successful WordPress restore.
The database is parsed read-only; PHP and SQL are never executed.
No hosting control-panel, DNS, mailbox, wp-config.php or server-root backup is assumed.

rank_math.note: Settings export is not a complete per-post SEO or redirect-rule export; use WXR and database too.

site_kit.note: PDF text is supplementary. Original PDF remains the visual source.
